name: customTool
description: Manage custom tools. Set 'action' to create, read, update, delete, or list. Custom tools are user-defined tools stored in data/tools/custom/<name>/ (folder-per-tool: <name>.json ToolConfig + index.js entry, with optional skill.md/prompt.json). They support skill guides with soft/hard/custom push modes.

action.description: Operation to perform: create, read, update, delete, list

name.description: Tool name (required for create, read, update, delete)

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for tool parameters (for create/update)

skillPushMode.description: Skill push mode: soft, hard, or custom (for create/update)

skillId.description: Skill ID for reading via skill tool (for create/update)

skillCustomPushText.description: Custom push text when skillPushMode is custom (for create/update)

skillTags.description: Tags for skill guide (stored in prompt.json)
